name: @phpsandbox/sdk
description: The TypeScript SDK for PHPSandbox cloud development environments
author: PHPSandbox

scripts.build: npm run build:tsc && npm run build:browser
scripts.test: npm run build:tsc && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.smoke:pr: npm run build:tsc && vitest run --config tests/smoke/vitest.config.ts tests/smoke/pr
scripts.smoke:nightly: npm run build:tsc && vitest run --config tests/smoke/vitest.config.ts tests/smoke/pr tests/smoke/nightly --exclude tests/smoke/nightly/publication.smoke.ts
scripts.smoke:publications: npm run build:tsc && vitest run --reporter=verbose --config tests/smoke/vitest.config.ts tests/smoke/nightly/publication.smoke.ts
scripts.smoke:composer-credentials: npm run build:tsc && vitest run --reporter=verbose --config tests/smoke/vitest.config.ts tests/smoke/integrations/composer-credentials.smoke.ts
scripts.smoke:beacon: npm run build:tsc && vitest run --reporter=verbose --config tests/smoke/vitest.config.ts tests/smoke/integrations/beacon.smoke.ts
scripts.smoke:feedback-widget: npm run build:tsc && vitest run --reporter=verbose --config tests/smoke/vitest.config.ts tests/smoke/integrations/feedback-widget.smoke.ts
scripts.smoke:reaper: npm run build:tsc && vitest run --reporter=verbose --config tests/smoke/vitest.config.ts tests/smoke/maintenance/resources.reaper.smoke.ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm test && npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.bumpAndPublish: npm version patch && npm publish --access public
scripts.format: oxfmt --write src tests package.json tsconfig.json vitest.config.ts build.mjs .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check src tests package.json tsconfig.json vitest.config.ts build.mjs .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run smoke:typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm pack --dry-run
